entries.dialogueText: "Or a way to make sure you still have resources for years to come."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""It's an investment, Your Majesty...."
entries.dialogueText: "It's an investment, Your Majesty. Into the future of this region."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""As Wruhec wrote, 'Reach not for th..."
entries.dialogueText: "As Wruhec wrote, 'Reach not for the stars above your head..."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""...before tending to the soil bene..."
entries.dialogueText: "...before tending to the soil beneath your feet."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Think about it from a financial pe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think about it from a financial perspective. Peace between Derdia and Morella could be lucrative for all of us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What will happen when she allies w..."
entries.dialogueText: "What will happen when she allies with the CSP? Your insurgents will get blown to smithereens."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""'Yet even the most imposing of mou..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Yet even the most imposing of mountains may still be shaped by the gentle rains of understanding'."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't care what he wrote. The la..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't care what he wrote. The law is the law."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal nodded approvingly."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal nodded approvingly.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""We will talk to Saltana. I will re..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will talk to Saltana. I will respect her borders if she respects my pilgrims' rights."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""We in Derdia only recognize one la..."
entries.dialogueText: "We in Derdia only recognize one law. The law of the divine."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""'In the realm of discourse, succin..."
entries.dialogueText: "'In the realm of discourse, succinct truths are the sharpest blades of wisdom'."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree, Supreme Wiseman. We will..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree, Supreme Wiseman. We will get Saltana to recognize your people's right to their ancestral land."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Halaita. If it is said, so it will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita. If it is said, so it will be."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""In that case...""
entries.dialogueText: "In that case..."

entries.dialogueText: "We are fighting a war. Building a pipeline would be a waste of much-needed resources."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A faint smile appeared on Sal's lip..."
entries.dialogueText: A faint smile appeared on Sal's lips.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A pipeline is out of the question...."
entries.dialogueText: "A pipeline is out of the question. I'm sorry."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's a deal, Supreme Wiseman. We w..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a deal, Supreme Wiseman. We will extend the pipeline if you leave Morella alone."
entries.menuText: "It's a deal, Supreme Wiseman. We will extend the pipeline if you leave Morella alone." [-2 Energy For +4 Budget Per Turn, -2 Budget Per Turn For Pipeline]

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Are you aware of my country's weap..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you aware of my country's weapons capabilities? We are more than prepared to fight for our right to holy pilgrimage."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Riches are useless if we are unabl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Riches are useless if we are unable to express our gratitude to the Lord who provided them."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Tell Ms. Saltana I will talk to he..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell Ms. Saltana I will talk to her. But only if the King of Rizia is present to act as an intermediary."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That sounds fair enough. I'm happy..."
entries.dialogueText: "That sounds fair enough. I'm happy to help."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope you are ready to compromise..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you are ready to compromise. Derdians are not automatically entitled to enter Morella, after all."

entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""You spoke in our favor at the Alli..."
entries.dialogueText: "You spoke in our favor at the Alliance of Nations. I know you are not entirely on Morella's side."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I was wary of you after your words..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was wary of you after your words at the Alliance of Nations. But your actions on behalf of Golcondists have spoken volumes."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Yes, that is so.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, that is so."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sat back on his cushion, looking..."
entries.dialogueText: He sat back on his cushion, looking defiant.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""We were once one kingdom. St. Wruh..."
entries.dialogueText: "We were once one kingdom. St. Wruhec knew nothing of these modern-day borders."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Make sure she is aware that I will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Make sure she is aware that I will not simply back down. The more she tries to block our holy pilgrimage, the more fiercely we will fight."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Wruhec himself would not have appr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wruhec himself would not have approved of your attitude, Supreme Wiseman. 'The most steadfast heart must be willing to sway, for in yielding, it finds strength.'"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Did he not also write, 'As the mou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did he not also write, 'As the mountain stand still against the tempest, so too must one hold firm to their convictions'?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""There is one thing we Derdians nee..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is one thing we Derdians need more than access to sacred sites. Energy."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I've heard about your partnership..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've heard about your partnership with Morella. Extend the pipeline to Derdia, and I will order our pilgrims away from Morella's borders."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's your only request? Nothing..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's your only request? Nothing would make me happier than to pursue an energy partnership with Derdia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""When two like souls converge, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "When two like souls converge, the Divine smiles upon them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Respectfully, Supreme Wiseman, we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Respectfully, Supreme Wiseman, we barely have enough energy to sell to Morella, let alone Derdia."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""So Rizia's legendary gas wealth is..."
entries.dialogueText: "So Rizia's legendary gas wealth is a myth."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked disappointed."
entries.dialogueText: He looked disappointed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't do that. Too much could go..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't do that. Too much could go wrong."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Do you not trust us, Your Majesty?..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you not trust us, Your Majesty? The word of a Derdian is bond."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Or is it your Morellan friends you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or is it your Morellan friends you are worried about?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He wrote a lot, didn't he?""
entries.dialogueText: "He wrote a lot, didn't he?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That was easier than I expected.""
entries.dialogueText: "That was easier than I expected."
